thread:
noah_support: FYI Sparrow Health reports a regression in regenerate behavior after the Mar 9 Dedicated runtime push. Symptoms: context bleed between patient prompts and mid-answer truncation.
casey_cs: Repro steps from customer attached. They are on Dedicated cluster-42, model redwood-v2-7b-quant, runtime rtf-2026-03-09-58a3, session s-0k2j9. They say the issue began after the 2026-03-09 deploy.
maria_pm: How severe is it? Wrong PHI mapping or just truncation?
olivia_sales: Sparrow is an enterprise pilot; legal flagged incorrect patient summaries. They want this prioritized.
casey_cs: Customer minimal repro (they reuse sessions across patients):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-7b-quant",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a clinical summarizer."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize patient visit A: [~6k token patient notes]"},
    {"role":"user","content":"Follow-up: list outstanding meds."}
  ],
  "stream": false,
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
noah_support: Observed: sometimes the reply contains fragments from a different patient earlier in the session; other times it cuts off around 120 tokens mid-sentence. Expected: correct summary for provided context.
casey_cs: Customer logs show KV cache misses and a response_truncate error. Excerpt:
```
[WARN] kv_cache_miss: key=0x7abf...
[ERROR] response_truncate: tokens_emitted=123, expected_max=256
request_id=rx-7f4c, session=s-0k2j9
```
vikram_eng: Important: did they enable prefix KV caching and prefetch? Need exact GPU type and build hash.
noah_support: Customer confirms kv_cache=on and prefetch=enabled; GPUs: A10g; runtime: rtf-2026-03-09-58a3.
maria_pm: This can expose PHI mismatches. Marking P0 until we confirm blast radius and repro.
kyle_se: I'll own this. Hypothesis: collision/eviction in KV cache under prefetch on the quantized runtime path after recent kernel/hash changes. Plan:
- reproduce on a Dedicated-like infra with same model + quant + prefetch flags
- diff against rtf-2026-02-28 to confirm regression
- collect KV cache traces, token ids, and kernel logs
- validate tokenizer offsets and attention window handling
ella_prod: If urgent, we can schedule a rollback for cluster-42; need a rollback window and checklist.
noah_support: Customer can accept a short outage; wants a fix asap. Sales requests prioritization.
casey_cs: Minimal curl the customer provided:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://dedicated-api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '@repro.json'
```
repro.json contains the body above with the ~6k token context.
noah_support: Customer notes bug tends to surface once a session has >4 prior distinct patient contexts.
kyle_se: Created ENG-4821 and starting local repro. Reproduces ~70% of runs when prefetch=on. Collecting deterministic traces and KV key dumps.
inc_bot: ENG-4821 created by kyle_se: "Dedicated: kv-cache collision / regen context bleed on quantized runtime"
noah_support: Action items:
- casey_cs: upload full session dump + repro payloads to ENG-4821 (owner)
- kyle_se: reproduce and root cause (owner)
- maria_pm: coordinate priority and customer comms (owner)
- ella_prod: prepare rollback canary plan (owner)
vikram_eng: I'll review traces and request kernel-level traces if repro becomes deterministic.
maria_pm: Setting priority P0 until confirmed. Initial customer update in 2 hours.
casey_cs: Sent customer a short update: "Engineering is investigating; we have an owner and will update in 2 hours." :thumbsup: 
kyle_se: Update: local repro confirmed. Collecting deterministic traces and KV key dumps. Expect a follow-up in 3-4 hours.
